goal.en: Give a warm, well-structured farewell speech to your Brightway team.
goal.zh: 在 Brightway 的歡送會上，發表一段溫暖又得體的告別致詞。

background: office meeting room set up for a small party, long table with snacks, paper cups and a cake on a tray, balloons tied to chairs, large windows with an evening city view

intro.en: Your last Friday at Brightway. Someone has tied balloons to your chair.
intro.zh: 你在 Brightway 的最後一個星期五。有人在你的椅子上綁了氣球。

intro.en: Sam's right. Kai, would you like to say a few words?
intro.zh: 山姆說得對。凱，要不要說幾句話？

lines.en: The floor is yours.
lines.zh: 舞台交給你了。

choices.en: Thank you, everyone. I'll keep this short, since there's cake waiting.
choices.zh: 謝謝大家。我會長話短說，因為蛋糕還在等。
choices.tip: 開場先感謝，再用一句輕鬆的話拉近距離，是英文致詞的常見結構。

choices.en: Sorry, my English is not good. Please forgive my bad speech in advance.
choices.zh: 抱歉，我英文不好，先請大家原諒我講得不好。

lines.en: What? Your English is great! You literally pitch to clients!
lines.zh: 什麼？你英文超好的！你都在跟客戶做提案耶！

story.en: Your team spends the first two minutes reassuring you. The cake starts to melt.
story.zh: 團隊花了前兩分鐘安慰你。蛋糕開始融化了。

fail.why: 中文致詞常以「才疏學淺」自謙開場，但英文聽眾會當真，反而尷尬。直接感謝開場：Thank you, everyone.。

choices.en: Thank you everyone for come today. I will try to make my speech short.
choices.zh: 謝謝大家今天來。我會盡量講短一點。

lines.en: "For come"? Okay, okay, nerves. Take a breath, Kai.
lines.zh: For come？好啦好啦，緊張了。深呼吸，凱。

story.en: Sam gives you a thumbs-up that says "you've got this." Ms. Wong gives you a look that says "for coming."
story.zh: 山姆比了個「你可以的」讚。王經理的眼神則在說「是 for coming」。

fail.why: 介系詞 for 後面要接名詞或動名詞：Thank you for coming.。

lines.en: Smart move. Go on!
lines.zh: 聰明。繼續！

choices.en: First, I'd like to thank Ms. Wong for taking a chance on me.
choices.zh: 首先，我要感謝王經理願意給我機會。
choices.tip: I'd like to thank... for... 是正式致謝句型；take a chance on someone 是「願意冒險給某人機會」。

choices.en: First, I want to thank Ms. Wong for giving me a chance to grow up here.
choices.zh: 首先，我要謝謝王經理給我在這裡成長的機會。

lines.en: Grow up? You were already an adult when you came, Kai.
lines.zh: 長大？凱，你來的時候已經是大人了。

story.en: Sam asks if Brightway should start a daycare. Your heartfelt thanks becomes the office joke of the year.
story.zh: 山姆問 Brightway 是不是該開托兒所了。你真心的感謝變成年度辦公室笑話。

fail.why: 「成長」翻成 grow up 是指從小孩長成大人。職場上的成長要用 grow、learn 或 develop：Thank you for helping me grow.。

choices.en: First, thanks, Ms. Wong. You were too strict sometimes, but it's okay.
choices.zh: 首先，謝謝王經理。您有時候太嚴格，但沒關係啦。

lines.en: ...Thank you for that honest feedback, Kai.
lines.zh: ……謝謝你這麼坦白的回饋，凱。

story.en: The room goes very quiet. Sam suddenly becomes very interested in the cake.
story.zh: 會議室突然一片安靜。山姆突然對蛋糕產生濃厚興趣。

fail.why: 告別致詞時夾帶批評，會讓感謝變成酸話。只說正面的：I'd like to thank Ms. Wong for taking a chance on me.。

lines.en: I'm glad I did.
lines.zh: 我很慶幸我這麼做了。

lines.en: And what about me?
lines.zh: 那我呢？

choices.en: And Sam, I'll never forget how you showed me around on my first day.
choices.zh: 還有山姆，我永遠不會忘記第一天你帶我認識環境。
choices.tip: I'll never forget how/when... 搭配一個具體回憶，讓感謝更真誠動人。

choices.en: And Sam, I'll never forget my first day, when you teach me everything.
choices.zh: 還有山姆，我永遠不會忘記第一天你教我所有事情。

lines.en: When I "teach" you? I'm still teaching you? Right now?
lines.zh: 我「教」你？我現在還在教你？此時此刻？

story.en: Sam takes it as a promise of lifelong mentoring and adds you to his calendar for weekly calls.
story.zh: 山姆把這當成終身指導的承諾，把你加進他的每週通話行事曆。

fail.why: 回憶過去的事要用過去式：when you taught me everything。

choices.en: And Sam... actually, does anyone know who took my blue stapler? Anyone?
choices.zh: 還有山姆……話說，有人知道誰拿了我的藍色釘書機嗎？

lines.en: ...That's what you think of when you see me?
lines.zh: ……你看到我就想到這個？

story.en: The stapler is never found. Neither is the emotional moment you were building.
story.zh: 釘書機始終沒找到，你剛醞釀的感人氣氛也是。

fail.why: 致詞中點名感謝某人時，要接一段具體的正面回憶，不要突然岔題：I'll never forget how you...。

lines.en: Aw. Okay, I might cry.
lines.zh: 噢。好，我可能要哭了。

lines.en: What will you take with you from Brightway, Kai?
lines.zh: 凱，你會從 Brightway 帶走什麼？

choices.en: This job taught me that mistakes are okay, as long as you own them.
choices.zh: 這份工作讓我學到，犯錯沒關係，只要勇於承擔。
choices.tip: 用一句「我學到的事」做致詞的核心，讓聽眾記得你的成長。

choices.en: Here I learned so much, and I also ate a lot of bitter, you know.
choices.zh: 我在這裡學到很多，也吃了很多苦。

lines.en: You ate... bitter? Was it the office coffee?
lines.zh: 你吃了……苦的東西？是辦公室咖啡嗎？

story.en: Ms. Wong promises to upgrade the coffee machine. Nobody understands that you meant hard work.
story.zh: 王經理承諾會換一台更好的咖啡機。沒人聽懂你說的是辛苦。

fail.why: 「吃苦」直譯 eat bitter 英文聽不懂。可以說 I worked really hard. 或 I went through some tough times.。

choices.en: I learned a lot here. Honestly, though, the pay could've been better.
choices.zh: 我在這裡學到很多。不過老實說，薪水可以再高一點。

lines.en: Noted. For your replacement.
lines.zh: 記下了。給你的接班人參考。

story.en: Everyone laughs a little too loudly. Your replacement will thank you someday, but tonight it just feels awkward.
story.zh: 大家笑得有點太大聲。你的接班人有天會感謝你，但今晚只覺得尷尬。

fail.why: 告別致詞要保持正面，抱怨薪水會破壞氣氛。分享學到的事：This job taught me that...。

lines.en: Well said.
lines.zh: 說得好。

lines.en: Okay, glasses up! Toast time!
lines.zh: 好，舉杯！乾杯時間！

choices.en: So, to Brightway: thank you for lighting up my year. Cheers!
choices.zh: 那麼，敬 Brightway：謝謝你們點亮了我的這一年。乾杯！
choices.tip: 用 To + 對象 舉杯收尾，再加一句呼應公司特色的話，結尾就很漂亮。

choices.en: So, cheers to Brightway! Thank you for let me join this family.
choices.zh: 那麼，敬 Brightway！謝謝你們讓我加入這個大家庭。

lines.en: "For let me"? Ha! Okay, we'll let it go. Just this once.
lines.zh: For let me？哈！好啦，這次就放過你。

story.en: The toast still happens, but Sam quotes "for let me" in every message he sends you for a month.
story.zh: 還是有舉杯，但接下來一個月，山姆每則訊息都會引用 for let me。

fail.why: for 後面接動名詞：Thank you for letting me join.。

choices.en: Cheers! Bottoms up, everyone. Nobody stops until the glass is empty!
choices.zh: 乾杯！大家一口乾，杯子沒空不准停！

lines.en: Uh, Kai, it's sparkling juice. And sipping is totally fine here.
lines.zh: 呃，凱，這是氣泡果汁。而且在這裡小口喝完全沒問題。

story.en: Three coworkers chug sparkling juice out of politeness and get hiccups. The photos are memorable for the wrong reasons.
story.zh: 三位同事出於禮貌一口灌完氣泡果汁，然後開始打嗝。合照很難忘，但不是好的那種。

fail.why: 英文 Cheers 只是舉杯致意，不代表要乾杯喝完；勸人一口乾在英語職場會讓人不自在。簡單說 To Brightway! Cheers! 即可。

lines.en: To Kai!
lines.zh: 敬凱！

lines.en: To Kai! Now, seriously, cake.
lines.zh: 敬凱！好了，說真的，吃蛋糕。

story.en: Thanks, a memory, a lesson and a toast: a short speech that said everything. Ms. Wong quietly saves a slice of cake for you to take home.
story.zh: 感謝、回憶、心得、舉杯：一段簡短卻說盡一切的致詞。王經理悄悄留了一塊蛋糕讓你帶回家。

notes.explain: 正式致謝句型。for 後面接名詞或動名詞，例如 for your support、for taking a chance on me。

example.en: I'd like to thank my team for all their support.
example.zh: 我要感謝團隊的所有支持。

notes.explain: 後面接一個具體的回憶，比空泛的感謝更動人。注意回憶的內容要用過去式。

example.en: I'll never forget the day you helped me move.
example.zh: 我永遠不會忘記你幫我搬家的那天。

notes.explain: 表示對方冒了點風險、相信你，才給你機會。很適合在告別或得獎致詞中感謝主管。

example.en: Thank you for taking a chance on a new graduate.
example.zh: 謝謝您願意給一個社會新鮮人機會。

notes.explain: grow up 是從小孩長大成人；工作上的成長要說 grow、learn 或 develop。「吃苦」也不能直譯 eat bitter。

example.en: This job helped me grow as a person.
example.zh: 這份工作讓我在為人處事上成長了。

notes.en: Thanks, a memory, a lesson, a toast.
notes.explain: 英文告別致詞常見結構：感謝開場、點名致謝並附上回憶、分享學到的事、舉杯收尾。不用自謙開場，簡短溫暖最好。

example.en: Thank you all. I'll never forget this team. To Brightway!
example.zh: 謝謝大家。我永遠不會忘記這個團隊。敬 Brightway！
